inputs.name: GameDocumentRepository.constructor.root
inputs.description: Repository root used as the git working directory for commit reads and as the parent directory of game.json for working-tree reads and saves. The implementation does not validate its format.

inputs.name: GameDocumentRepository.read.commit
inputs.description: An optional full lowercase hexadecimal commit SHA used to read <commit>:game.json; a truthy value must be exactly 40 hex characters, while omitted or empty values select the working-tree file. Defaults to undefined.

inputs.name: GameDocumentRepository.save.document
inputs.description: The GameDocument to validate and serialize as tab-indented JSON with a trailing newline before replacing game.json. It must pass assertDocument and the serialized UTF-8 text must not exceed 1,048,576 bytes.

inputs.name: GameDocumentRepository.save.expectedRevision
inputs.description: Expected SHA-256 digest of the current game.json text, compared with the current content before a save. It must match exactly for the save to proceed; the implementation performs no separate format check.

outputs.name: GameDocumentRepository.read
outputs.description: Resolves to the parsed, validated document and the lowercase SHA-256 digest of the exact UTF-8 text that was read. Reading is limited to 1,048,576 bytes.

outputs.name: GameDocumentRepository.save
outputs.description: Resolves to the lowercase SHA-256 digest of the tab-indented JSON text written to game.json. The written text includes a trailing newline and must be no larger than 1,048,576 UTF-8 bytes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for a malformed commit, invalid document, file-size violation, or stale revision, and propagated for git and filesystem failures.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Rejected when JSON.parse cannot parse the text read from game.json.
